comments.author: PandaRider
comments.story: Markets are competitive if and only if P = NP
comments.why: Cited as explanation of P and NP
comments.text: I have taken algorithms courses. This video explains in detail: [VIDEO] In short, P means Polynomial time (i.e. markets can solve computation problems efficiently) and NP means Non-Deterministic Polynomial time (i.e. markets can verify solutions of computation problems efficiently but solutions are found by luck). If P != NP, it means luck CANNOT be engineered and markets are competitive.

comments.author: ColinWright
comments.story: Integer Factoring via Graph Three Colouring
comments.text: Because Graph Three Colouring[0][1] is NP-Complete[2][3] we can use it to solve any NP problem. Integer factoring is an NP problem[4] so we should be able to factor integers by using Graph Three Colouring. This post shows one way of doing that, and explains the techniques used to show directly that Graph Three Colouring is NP-Complete. [0] [LINK] [1] [LINK] [2] [LINK] [3] [VIDEO] [4] [LINK]
